question: Regarding the glucokinase enzyme, it can be stated that:

options.opa: It is expressed in the liver and beta cells of the pancreatic islets.
options.opb: It catalyzes the phosphorolytic cleavage of hepatic glycogen by releasing glucose-1-phosphate.
options.opc: The reaction of phosphorylation of glucose by the enzyme follows a michaelian kinetics.
options.opd: Insulin represses transcription of the hepatic glocokinase gene.
